name: peroneal-tiger-tail
instructions:
1. While in a seated position, position the tiger tail on the lateral aspect of the calf with one hand on either handle.
2. Adjust pressure into calf by applying more or less force through the hands.
3. Slowly roll up and down the length of the side of your calf for 20-30 seconds.
4. Repeat on the other side.
starting_position: 1. While in a seated position, position the tiger tail on the lateral aspect of the calf with one hand on either handle. 2. Adjust pressure into calf by applying more or less force through the hands.
